title: mail: Mailbox/query implementation
description:
Implement Mailbox/query in crates/mail/src/mailbox/query.rs: return all mailbox ids (from article_numbers list_groups), support filter by isSubscribed, support sort by name or sortOrder. Return QueryResponse with ids list, position, total, queryState.

Why: clients use Mailbox/query to enumerate mailboxes, often filtering to subscribed-only.

Acceptance: Mailbox/query with no filter returns all groups; Mailbox/query with isSubscribed=true returns only subscribed groups.
